//go:build integration

package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	courseclient "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/course"
	studentclient "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/http/student"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	diagnosticnats "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/transport/message/nats"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/diagnosticplan"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	natsgo "github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
)

// This finite harness uses owner-registered Course/Student HTTP providers and
// their actual PostgreSQL/scorer/outbox implementations. Root alone provisions
// databases and the dedicated stream. No result, outbox or placement is seeded.
// The only fixture write here is the exact rollout binding through its actual
// append-only repository. No browser, Teacher recovery, planning worker or
// Student path/mastery writer participates in the automatic placement phase.
func TestT18ActualDiagnosticPlacement(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("T18_ACTUAL_PLACEMENT") != "true" {
		t.Skip("owned actual T18 placement gate absent")
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("PLANNER_TEST_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil || (!infraAcceptanceDatabase(t, cfg, "planner") && (cfg.ConnConfig.Database != "remediation_t18_planner_test" || cfg.ConnConfig.Host != "127.0.0.1" || cfg.ConnConfig.Port != 58998)) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact owned Planner database required")
	}
	var student struct {
		URL               string `json:"url"`
		StudentID         string `json:"student_id"`
		GoalCode          string `json:"goal_code"`
		DirectionCode     string `json:"direction_code"`
		OnboardingVersion int64  `json:"onboarding_version"`
	}
	var course struct {
		URL      string `json:"url"`
		CourseID string `json:"course_id"`
	}
	t18ActualReadMetadata(t, "T18_STUDENT_READY_FILE", &student)
	t18ActualReadMetadata(t, "T18_COURSE_READY_FILE", &course)
	for _, address := range []string{student.URL, course.URL} {
		u, parseErr := url.Parse(address)
		if parseErr != nil || u.Scheme != "http" || u.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || u.User != nil || u.Path != "" {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: owned loopback providers required")
		}
	}
	broker, err := url.Parse(os.Getenv("T18_NATS_URL"))
	if err != nil || (!infraAcceptanceNATS(t, os.Getenv("T18_NATS_URL")) && (broker.Scheme != "nats" || broker.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || broker.User != nil)) {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: dedicated loopback broker required")
	}
	for _, names := range [][2]string{{"T18_STUDENT_TOKEN", "T18_STUDENT_PLANNER_TOKEN"}, {"T18_COURSE_TOKEN", "T18_COURSE_CATALOG_TOKEN"}} {
		if os.Getenv(names[0]) == "" || os.Getenv(names[1]) == "" || os.Getenv(names[0]) == os.Getenv(names[1]) {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: distinct owner credentials required")
		}
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 8*time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: Planner pool unavailable")
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	var database string
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT current_database()`).Scan(&database) != nil || database != cfg.ConnConfig.Database {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact Planner database unavailable")
	}
	infraAcceptanceDatabaseIdentity(t, ctx, pool)
	nc, err := natsgo.Connect(broker.String(), natsgo.Timeout(5*time.Second))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: dedicated NATS unavailable")
	}
	defer nc.Close()
	js, err := nc.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual JetStream unavailable")
	}
	stream, err := js.StreamInfo(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, natsgo.Context(ctx))
	if err != nil || len(stream.Config.Subjects) != 1 || stream.Config.Subjects[0] != domain.SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted || stream.Config.Retention != natsgo.WorkQueuePolicy {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: dedicated owned diagnostic stream required")
	}
	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 40 * time.Second, Transport: &http.Transport{Proxy: nil}, CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}
	defer client.CloseIdleConnections()
	h := t18ActualHTTP{t: t, ctx: ctx, client: client, studentURL: student.URL, courseURL: course.URL, studentID: student.StudentID}
	store := postgres.Store{Pool: pool}
	clock := t18ActualClock{}
	students := studentclient.Client{BaseURL: student.URL, ReadToken: os.Getenv("T18_STUDENT_TOKEN"), WriteToken: os.Getenv("T18_STUDENT_PLANNER_TOKEN"), HTTPClient: client}
	courses := courseclient.Client{BaseURL: course.URL, InternalToken: os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_TOKEN"), DiagnosticCatalogToken: os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_CATALOG_TOKEN"), HTTPClient: client}
	binding, bindingErr := store.GetLatestDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(ctx, student.GoalCode, student.DirectionCode)
	if errors.Is(bindingErr, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		binding = domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBinding{GoalCode: student.GoalCode, DirectionCode: student.DirectionCode, CourseID: course.CourseID, BindingRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1, Active: true, CreatedAt: clock.Now()}
		binding.BindingDigest, err = domain.DiagnosticBootstrapBindingDigest(binding)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal("binding digest failed")
		}
		binding, _, bindingErr = store.ProvisionDiagnosticBootstrapBinding(ctx, binding)
	}
	if bindingErr != nil || binding.CourseID != course.CourseID || !binding.Active {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: exact rollout binding unavailable")
	}
	issuer := diagnosticplan.Issuer{Plans: store, Reservations: store, Placements: store, Students: students, Courses: courses, Clock: clock}
	bootstrap := diagnosticplan.Bootstrap{Issuer: issuer, Plans: store, Receipts: store, Students: students, Clock: clock}
	processor := diagnosticplan.PlacementConsumer{Plans: store, Placements: store, Students: students, Clock: clock}
	// A prior failed harness may leave an actual committed owner result pending.
	// Recover through the production durable before taking the repeat baseline;
	// Issuer correctly requires the prior immutable placement for a retake.
	startupRecoveredPending := false
	contextDigest, digestErr := domain.DiagnosticBootstrapContextDigest(student.StudentID, student.OnboardingVersion, binding)
	if digestErr != nil {
		t.Fatal("bootstrap recovery context unavailable")
	}
	if latest, latestErr := store.GetLatest(ctx, student.StudentID, course.CourseID, contextDigest); latestErr == nil {
		if _, placementErr := store.GetDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, latest.Plan.ID); errors.Is(placementErr, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			result, readErr := students.GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult(ctx, student.StudentID, latest.Plan.ID)
			if readErr != nil {
				t.Fatalf("pending owner result recovery read failed: error_type=%T", readErr)
			}
			if domain.ValidateDiagnosticResult(result, latest.Plan) != nil {
				t.Fatal("pending owner result recovery binding failed")
			}
			recovery, recoverErr := diagnosticnats.NewDiagnosticResultConsumer(ctx, broker.String(), processor)
			if recoverErr != nil {
				t.Fatal("pending actual consumer recovery constructor failed")
			}
			t18ActualEventually(t, 40*time.Second, func() bool {
				placement, placementErr := processor.Get(ctx, student.StudentID, latest.Plan.ID)
				return placementErr == nil && placement.ResultDigest == result.ResultDigest
			}, "prior actual committed-result placement recovery")
			t18ActualEventually(t, 10*time.Second, func() bool {
				info, infoErr := js.ConsumerInfo(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, diagnosticnats.DiagnosticPlacementDurable, natsgo.Context(ctx))
				return infoErr == nil && info.NumAckPending == 0 && info.NumPending == 0
			}, "prior actual pending deliveries settled")
			recovery.Close()
			startupRecoveredPending = true
		} else if placementErr != nil {
			t.Fatal("prior placement recovery read failed")
		}
	} else if !errors.Is(latestErr, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatal("prior frozen plan recovery read failed")
	}
	before := h.state()
	baselinePlacements := t18ActualCount(t, ctx, pool, `SELECT count(*) FROM diagnostic_assessment_placement_decision WHERE student_id=$1`, student.StudentID)
	assertNoLearning := func() {
		state := h.state()
		for _, key := range []string{"learning_actions", "learning_evidence", "target_mastery", "learning_paths", "course_assignments", "lesson_facts"} {
			if state[key] != before[key] || state[key] != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected Student fact in %s", key)
			}
		}
		if t18ActualCount(t, ctx, pool, `SELECT count(*) FROM course_plan_request WHERE student_id=$1`, student.StudentID) != 0 || t18ActualCount(t, ctx, pool, `SELECT count(*) FROM planner_outbox WHERE student_id=$1`, student.StudentID) != 0 {
			t.Fatal("placement implicitly created planning intent")
		}
	}
	newPlan := func() domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan {
		contextDigest, digestErr := domain.DiagnosticBootstrapContextDigest(student.StudentID, student.OnboardingVersion, binding)
		if digestErr != nil {
			t.Fatal("bootstrap context failed")
		}
		input := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestV1{Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBootstrapRequestSchemaV1, ExpectedOnboardingVersion: student.OnboardingVersion}
		if latest, latestErr := store.GetLatest(ctx, student.StudentID, course.CourseID, contextDigest); latestErr == nil {
			revision := latest.Plan.PlanRevision
			input.ExpectedPreviousRevision = &revision
		} else if !errors.Is(latestErr, domain.ErrNotFound) {
			t.Fatal("latest plan unavailable")
		}
		key := uuid.NewString()
		issued, created, issueErr := bootstrap.Start(ctx, student.StudentID, key, input)
		if issueErr != nil || !created {
			t.Fatalf("actual bootstrap/reservation failed: created=%t error_type=%T error=%v", created, issueErr, issueErr)
		}
		replayed, replayCreated, replayErr := bootstrap.Start(ctx, student.StudentID, key, input)
		if replayErr != nil || replayCreated || replayed != issued {
			t.Fatal("bootstrap receipt replay changed")
		}
		record, recordErr := store.GetDiagnosticByID(ctx, issued.PlanID)
		if recordErr != nil || domain.ValidateDiagnosticPlanRecord(record) != nil {
			t.Fatal("actual frozen plan missing")
		}
		return record.Plan
	}

	first := newPlan()
	// Task DTOs deliberately omit Course identity, so the actual Student client
	// requires the registered Course lesson read too. Verify the complete read
	// composition before handing an otherwise unusable attempt to the browser.
	var lessonProjection struct {
		ID       string `json:"id"`
		CourseID string `json:"course_id"`
	}
	h.request(http.MethodGet, course.URL+"/internal/lesson/get-internal-lesson/"+first.Assessments[0].LessonID, os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_TOKEN"), "", nil, http.StatusOK, &lessonProjection)
	if lessonProjection.ID != first.Assessments[0].LessonID || lessonProjection.CourseID != first.CourseID {
		t.Fatal("actual Course lesson identity read unavailable")
	}
	h.request(http.MethodGet, student.URL+"/api/v1/student/diagnostic-assessments/"+first.ID+"/tasks/"+first.Assessments[0].TaskID, "", "", nil, http.StatusOK, nil)
	var firstResult domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult
	resultFile := os.Getenv("T18_ACTUAL_RESULT_FILE")
	browserMode := os.Getenv("T18_BROWSER_COMPLETE") == "true"
	_, markerErr := os.Stat(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(resultFile), "green-browser-request"))
	_, doneErr := os.Stat(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(resultFile), "browser-done"))
	browserMode = browserMode || (markerErr == nil && os.IsNotExist(doneErr))
	if browserMode {
		ready, done := os.Getenv("T18_BROWSER_READY_FILE"), os.Getenv("T18_BROWSER_DONE_FILE")
		if ready == "" {
			ready = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(resultFile), "browser-ready.json")
		}
		if done == "" {
			done = filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(resultFile), "browser-done")
		}
		if ready == "" || done == "" {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: browser orchestration files required")
		}
		if _, statErr := os.Lstat(done); !os.IsNotExist(statErr) {
			t.Fatal("SETUP: browser completion marker must be absent")
		}
		t18ActualWriteExclusive(t, ready, map[string]any{"student_url": student.URL, "student_id": student.StudentID, "course_id": course.CourseID, "plan_id": first.ID, "attempt_id": first.ID, "plan_revision": first.PlanRevision, "onboarding_version": student.OnboardingVersion, "plan_digest": first.PlanDigest})
		t.Log("actual reserved attempt ready for mounted browser; waiting for root browser-close marker")
		t18ActualEventually(t, 300*time.Second, func() bool { _, statErr := os.Stat(done); return statErr == nil }, "browser completion/close marker")
		firstResult, err = students.GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult(ctx, student.StudentID, first.ID)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("mounted browser official result read failed: error_type=%T owner_not_found=%t owner_unavailable=%t", err, errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable))
		}
		if domain.ValidateDiagnosticResult(firstResult, first) != nil {
			t.Fatal("mounted browser official result frozen-plan binding failed")
		}
	} else {
		firstResult = h.complete(first)
	}
	if _, err = store.GetDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, first.ID); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatal("placement appeared before consumer")
	}
	completed := h.state()
	if completed["results"] != before["results"]+1 || completed["outbox"] != before["outbox"]+1 {
		t.Fatal("actual HTTP completion did not commit one result and event")
	}
	// Reloads are reads only: they cannot trigger Planner or change Student facts.
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		h.request(http.MethodGet, student.URL+"/api/v1/student/diagnostic-assessments/"+first.ID, "", "", nil, http.StatusOK, nil)
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(completed, h.state()) {
		t.Fatal("read-only reload changed Student facts")
	}
	assertNoLearning()
	// Exercise fresh frozen-plan rejection before publishing the legitimate
	// owner event. MaxAckPending=1 intentionally prevents a queued new delivery
	// from bypassing a legitimate NAK delivery; the oracle preserves that limit.
	negative := domain.DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent{
		EventID: domain.DiagnosticResultCommittedEventID(first.ID), EventType: domain.SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted,
		CorrelationID: first.ID, CausationID: uuid.NewString(), StudentID: first.StudentID,
		OccurredAt: firstResult.CompletedAt, SchemaVersion: domain.DiagnosticResultCommittedSchemaV1,
		Data: domain.DiagnosticResultCommittedData{PlanID: first.ID, PlanRevision: first.PlanRevision, PlanDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("0", 64), ResultDigest: firstResult.ResultDigest},
	}
	negativeAck, err := js.PublishMsg(t18ActualEventMessage(t, negative), natsgo.Context(ctx))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("fresh frozen-plan mismatch publication failed")
	}
	negativeObserver := &t18ActualObserver{processor: processor}
	negativeConsumer, err := diagnosticnats.NewDiagnosticResultConsumer(ctx, broker.String(), negativeObserver)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("fresh mismatch actual consumer constructor failed")
	}
	t18ActualEventually(t, 10*time.Second, func() bool { return negativeObserver.rejected(first.ID) }, "fresh frozen-plan admission rejection")
	// TERM stops redelivery; it is not a successful processing ACK and does not
	// require raw WorkQueue message deletion. Observe actual durable settlement.
	t18ActualEventually(t, 5*time.Second, func() bool {
		info, infoErr := js.ConsumerInfo(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, diagnosticnats.DiagnosticPlacementDurable, natsgo.Context(ctx))
		return infoErr == nil && info.NumAckPending == 0 && info.NumPending == 0 && info.Delivered.Stream >= negativeAck.Sequence
	}, "fresh mismatch broker TERM settlement")
	negativeConsumer.Close()
	freshTerminated := negativeObserver.rejected(first.ID)
	if _, err = store.GetDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, first.ID); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatal("fresh mismatched event created placement")
	}
	assertNoLearning()
	// Cut the relay's perception of success only after the actual publisher has
	// received a real JetStream PubACK. The immutable outbox remains pending,
	// while the original broker delivery already exists without a consumer.
	publicationBefore, err := js.StreamInfo(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, natsgo.Context(ctx))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("actual stream before publish cut unavailable")
	}
	h.request(http.MethodPost, student.URL+"/__t18/publish-cut", os.Getenv("T18_STUDENT_TOKEN"), "", map[string]bool{"enabled": true}, http.StatusNoContent, nil)
	t18ActualEventually(t, 20*time.Second, func() bool {
		var outcome struct {
			Succeeded bool `json:"delivery_succeeded"`
		}
		status := h.request(http.MethodPost, student.URL+"/__t18/relay", os.Getenv("T18_STUDENT_TOKEN"), "", map[string]any{}, 0, &outcome)
		state := h.state()
		if state["actual_cut_used"] == before["actual_cut_used"] {
			if status != http.StatusOK || !outcome.Succeeded {
				t.Fatal("owner relay failed before actual own publication cut")
			}
			return false
		}
		if state["actual_cut_used"] != before["actual_cut_used"]+1 || status != http.StatusServiceUnavailable || outcome.Succeeded || state["published"] != before["published"] {
			t.Fatal("actual PubACK ambiguity did not retain pending owner outbox")
		}
		return true
	}, "actual successful publisher followed by lost relay acknowledgement")
	publicationCut, err := js.StreamInfo(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, natsgo.Context(ctx))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("actual stream after publish cut unavailable")
	}
	var publishedMessage *natsgo.RawStreamMsg
	for sequence := publicationBefore.State.LastSeq + 1; sequence <= publicationCut.State.LastSeq; sequence++ {
		candidate, readErr := js.GetMsg(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, sequence, natsgo.Context(ctx))
		if readErr != nil {
			t.Fatal("actual pending publication read failed")
		}
		if candidate.Header.Get("X-Correlation-ID") == first.ID {
			if publishedMessage != nil {
				t.Fatal("publish cut produced duplicate broker messages")
			}
			publishedMessage = candidate
		}
	}
	if publishedMessage == nil {
		t.Fatal("real publisher cut did not leave own broker message")
	}
	publicationEnvelope := natsgo.NewMsg(publishedMessage.Subject)
	publicationEnvelope.Header, publicationEnvelope.Data = publishedMessage.Header, publishedMessage.Data
	firstEvent, err := diagnosticnats.DecodeDiagnosticResultMessage(publicationEnvelope)
	if err != nil || firstEvent.EventID != domain.DiagnosticResultCommittedEventID(first.ID) || publishedMessage.Header.Get(natsgo.MsgIdHdr) != firstEvent.EventID || firstEvent.Data.ResultDigest != firstResult.ResultDigest {
		t.Fatal("actual publish ambiguity envelope identity mismatch")
	}
	h.relayUntil(before["published"] + 1)
	publicationRetried, err := js.StreamInfo(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, natsgo.Context(ctx))
	if err != nil || publicationRetried.State.LastSeq != publicationCut.State.LastSeq || publicationRetried.State.Msgs != publicationCut.State.Msgs {
		t.Fatal("publisher retry did not broker-deduplicate the stable event")
	}
	publicationWire, err := js.GetMsg(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, publishedMessage.Sequence, natsgo.Context(ctx))
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(publicationWire.Data, publishedMessage.Data) || !reflect.DeepEqual(publicationWire.Header, publishedMessage.Header) {
		t.Fatal("publisher retry changed original broker wire")
	}
	stream, err = js.StreamInfo(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, natsgo.Context(ctx))
	if err != nil || stream.State.Msgs < 1 {
		t.Fatal("actual committed event not pending in JetStream")
	}
	h.outage(true)
	defer h.outage(false)
	observed := &t18ActualObserver{processor: processor}
	consumer, err := diagnosticnats.NewDiagnosticResultConsumer(ctx, broker.String(), observed)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("actual consumer constructor failed")
	}
	t18ActualEventually(t, 15*time.Second, func() bool { return observed.has(first.ID, true, false) }, "transient owner failure/NAK")
	consumer.Close()
	if _, err = store.GetDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, first.ID); !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatal("Student outage created placement")
	}
	h.outage(false)
	consumer, err = diagnosticnats.NewDiagnosticResultConsumer(ctx, broker.String(), observed)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("actual consumer reconstruction failed")
	}
	t18ActualEventually(t, 20*time.Second, func() bool { return observed.has(first.ID, false, true) }, "automatic placement after consumer restart")
	t18ActualAwaitACK(t, ctx, broker.String())
	consumer.Close()
	firstDecision, err := processor.Get(ctx, student.StudentID, first.ID)
	if err != nil || firstDecision.ResultDigest != firstResult.ResultDigest {
		t.Fatal("actual placement binding failed")
	}
	assertNoLearning()

	// A new actual retake supplies the commit/lost-ACK fault. The manual driver
	// uses the exact production decoder and processor; only ACK is withheld.
	second := newPlan()
	secondResult := h.complete(second)
	h.relayUntil(before["published"] + 2)
	sub, err := js.PullSubscribe(domain.SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted, diagnosticnats.DiagnosticPlacementDurable, natsgo.Bind(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, diagnosticnats.DiagnosticPlacementDurable), natsgo.ManualAck())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("actual fixed durable binding failed")
	}
	message := t18ActualFetchOwn(t, ctx, sub, second.ID, processor)
	metadata, err := message.Metadata()
	if err != nil || metadata.Stream != diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream || metadata.Consumer != diagnosticnats.DiagnosticPlacementDurable {
		t.Fatal("actual delivery metadata mismatch")
	}
	event, err := diagnosticnats.DecodeDiagnosticResultMessage(message)
	if err != nil || event.Data.ResultDigest != secondResult.ResultDigest {
		t.Fatal("actual producer envelope/digest mismatch")
	}
	decision, created, err := processor.ProcessCommittedResult(ctx, event)
	if err != nil || !created {
		t.Fatal("actual consumer commit before lost ACK failed")
	}
	if err = sub.Unsubscribe(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("lost ACK subscription close failed")
	}
	nc.Close() // No ACK/NAK/TERM; server retains the actual delivery until AckWait.
	h.outage(true)
	replayObserver := &t18ActualObserver{processor: processor}
	consumer, err = diagnosticnats.NewDiagnosticResultConsumer(ctx, broker.String(), replayObserver)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("lost ACK consumer reconstruction failed")
	}
	t.Log("placement committed; ACK intentionally lost; awaiting natural fixed 30-second redelivery")
	t18ActualEventually(t, 45*time.Second, func() bool { return replayObserver.has(second.ID, false, false) }, "natural redelivery committed receipt replay while Student unavailable")
	t18ActualAwaitACK(t, ctx, broker.String())
	consumer.Close()
	replayedDecision, err := processor.Get(ctx, student.StudentID, second.ID)
	if err != nil || replayedDecision != decision {
		t.Fatal("lost ACK redelivery changed immutable placement")
	}
	h.outage(false)

	// Force a wire duplicate without the broker deduplication header. Semantic
	// dedupe must therefore come from the immutable PostgreSQL placement.
	nc, err = natsgo.Connect(broker.String(), natsgo.Timeout(5*time.Second))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("dedicated broker reconnect failed")
	}
	defer nc.Close()
	js, err = nc.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("JetStream reconnect failed")
	}
	sub, err = js.PullSubscribe(domain.SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted, diagnosticnats.DiagnosticPlacementDurable, natsgo.Bind(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, diagnosticnats.DiagnosticPlacementDurable), natsgo.ManualAck())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("fixed durable rebind failed")
	}
	defer func() {
		if closeErr := sub.Unsubscribe(); closeErr != nil && !errors.Is(closeErr, natsgo.ErrBadSubscription) {
			t.Error("durable unsubscribe failed")
		}
	}()
	duplicate := t18ActualEventMessage(t, event)
	if _, err = js.PublishMsg(duplicate, natsgo.Context(ctx)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("duplicate publish failed")
	}
	duplicateDelivery := t18ActualFetchOwn(t, ctx, sub, second.ID, processor)
	if err = diagnosticnats.HandleDiagnosticResultMessage(ctx, duplicateDelivery, processor); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("duplicate delivery was not safely ACKed")
	}
	// Same event identity with a different result digest must TERM, not replay.
	bad := event
	bad.Data.ResultDigest = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("0", 64)
	if _, err = js.PublishMsg(t18ActualEventMessage(t, bad), natsgo.Context(ctx)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("mismatched reference test publish failed")
	}
	badDelivery := t18ActualFetchOwn(t, ctx, sub, second.ID, processor)
	if !errors.Is(diagnosticnats.HandleDiagnosticResultMessage(ctx, badDelivery, processor), domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatal("payload mismatch not rejected")
	}
	malformed := t18ActualEventMessage(t, event)
	malformed.Header.Add("X-Event-ID", event.EventID)
	if _, err = js.PublishMsg(malformed, natsgo.Context(ctx)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal("malformed header test publish failed")
	}
	badDelivery = t18ActualFetchOwn(t, ctx, sub, second.ID, processor)
	if !errors.Is(diagnosticnats.HandleDiagnosticResultMessage(ctx, badDelivery, processor), domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatal("duplicate header not rejected")
	}
	finalDecision, err := processor.Get(ctx, student.StudentID, second.ID)
	if err != nil || finalDecision != decision || t18ActualCount(t, ctx, pool, `SELECT count(*) FROM diagnostic_assessment_placement_decision WHERE student_id=$1`, student.StudentID) != baselinePlacements+2 {
		t.Fatal("duplicate/invalid delivery changed placement facts")
	}
	final := h.state()
	if final["attempts"] != before["attempts"]+2 || final["results"] != before["results"]+2 || final["submissions"] != before["submissions"]+int64(len(first.Assessments)+len(second.Assessments)) || final["outbox"] != before["outbox"]+2 || final["published"] != before["published"]+2 {
		t.Fatal("delivery faults doubled Student completion facts")
	}
	for _, pair := range []struct {
		plan   domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan
		result domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult
	}{{first, firstResult}, {second, secondResult}} {
		actual, readErr := students.GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult(ctx, student.StudentID, pair.plan.ID)
		if readErr != nil || actual != pair.result {
			t.Fatal("delivery/reload changed official Student result")
		}
	}
	assertNoLearning()
	t18ActualEventually(t, 5*time.Second, func() bool {
		info, infoErr := js.ConsumerInfo(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, diagnosticnats.DiagnosticPlacementDurable, natsgo.Context(ctx))
		return infoErr == nil && info.NumAckPending == 0
	}, "duplicate/invalid deliveries settled")
	if resultFile == "" {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: actual safe result path required")
	}
	t18ActualWriteExclusive(t, resultFile, map[string]any{"classification": "actual owner-registered HTTP/scorer/PostgreSQL/outbox/JetStream and Planner PostgreSQL placement; curated Course fixture; no authoring claim", "student_id": student.StudentID, "first_plan_id": first.ID, "second_plan_id": second.ID, "first_route": firstDecision.RouteCode, "second_route": decision.RouteCode, "first_decision_digest": firstDecision.DecisionDigest, "second_decision_digest": decision.DecisionDigest, "browser_completion": browserMode, "browser_recovery_participated": false, "automatic_consumer_after_outage_restart": true, "lost_ack_natural_redelivery": true, "durable_ack_wait_seconds": 30, "producer_publish_ack_ambiguity": true, "producer_publish_cut_delta": final["actual_cut_used"] - before["actual_cut_used"], "producer_event_id": firstEvent.EventID, "producer_message_sequence": publishedMessage.Sequence, "producer_retry_same_wire_and_broker_sequence": true, "fresh_frozen_plan_mismatch_terminated": freshTerminated, "valid_event_consumed_after_fresh_negative": true, "startup_recovered_prior_pending_result": startupRecoveredPending, "duplicate_acked": true, "payload_mismatch_terminated": true, "duplicate_header_terminated": true, "read_only_reload_unchanged": true, "official_results_unchanged": true, "before": before, "after": final, "placement_delta": 2, "course_plan_requests": 0, "implicit_student_learning_facts": 0})
}

type t18ActualClock struct{}

func (t18ActualClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond) }

type t18ActualObservation struct {
	planID          string
	failed, created bool
}
type t18ActualObserver struct {
	processor       diagnosticplan.PlacementConsumer
	mu              sync.Mutex
	calls           []t18ActualObservation
	rejectedPlanIDs []string
}

func (o *t18ActualObserver) ProcessCommittedResult(ctx context.Context, event domain.DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent) (domain.DiagnosticPlacement, bool, error) {
	decision, created, err := o.processor.ProcessCommittedResult(ctx, event)
	o.mu.Lock()
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		o.rejectedPlanIDs = append(o.rejectedPlanIDs, event.Data.PlanID)
	}
	// The outage witness must represent a retryable actual owner error, not a
	// validation failure which the transport would permanently terminate.
	if err == nil || errors.Is(err, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable) {
		o.calls = append(o.calls, t18ActualObservation{event.Data.PlanID, errors.Is(err, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable), created})
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()
	return decision, created, err
}
func (o *t18ActualObserver) has(planID string, failed, created bool) bool {
	o.mu.Lock()
	defer o.mu.Unlock()
	for _, call := range o.calls {
		if call == (t18ActualObservation{planID, failed, created}) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func (o *t18ActualObserver) rejected(planID string) bool {
	o.mu.Lock()
	defer o.mu.Unlock()
	for _, rejectedID := range o.rejectedPlanIDs {
		if rejectedID == planID {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

type t18ActualHTTP struct {
	t                                *testing.T
	ctx                              context.Context
	client                           *http.Client
	studentURL, courseURL, studentID string
}

func (h t18ActualHTTP) request(method, address, token, key string, body any, status int, output any) int {
	h.t.Helper()
	var reader io.Reader
	if body != nil {
		raw, err := json.Marshal(body)
		if err != nil {
			h.t.Fatal("request encoding failed")
		}
		reader = bytes.NewReader(raw)
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(h.ctx, method, address, reader)
	if err != nil {
		h.t.Fatal("owner request construction failed")
	}
	req.Header.Set("X-User-ID", h.studentID)
	req.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	if token != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
	}
	if key != "" {
		req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", key)
	}
	if body != nil {
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	}
	response, err := h.client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		h.t.Fatal("owner HTTP request failed")
	}
	raw, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(response.Body, 1<<20))
	closeErr := response.Body.Close()
	if readErr != nil || closeErr != nil || (status != 0 && response.StatusCode != status) {
		h.t.Fatalf("owner HTTP method %s expected status %d, got %d", method, status, response.StatusCode)
	}
	if output != nil && json.Unmarshal(raw, output) != nil {
		h.t.Fatal("owner response decoding failed")
	}
	return response.StatusCode
}
func (h t18ActualHTTP) state() map[string]int64 {
	var raw map[string]json.RawMessage
	h.request(http.MethodGet, h.studentURL+"/__t18/state", os.Getenv("T18_STUDENT_TOKEN"), "", nil, http.StatusOK, &raw)
	state := map[string]int64{}
	for _, key := range []string{"attempts", "results", "submissions", "outbox", "published", "actual_cut_used", "learning_actions", "learning_evidence", "target_mastery", "learning_paths", "course_assignments", "lesson_facts"} {
		var count int64
		if json.Unmarshal(raw[key], &count) != nil {
			h.t.Fatal("actual Student fact projection missing")
		}
		state[key] = count
	}
	return state
}
func (h t18ActualHTTP) outage(enabled bool) {
	h.request(http.MethodPost, h.studentURL+"/__t18/outage", os.Getenv("T18_STUDENT_TOKEN"), "", map[string]bool{"enabled": enabled}, http.StatusNoContent, nil)
}
func (h t18ActualHTTP) relayUntil(published int64) {
	t18ActualEventually(h.t, 20*time.Second, func() bool {
		h.request(http.MethodPost, h.studentURL+"/__t18/relay", os.Getenv("T18_STUDENT_TOKEN"), "", map[string]any{}, http.StatusOK, nil)
		return h.state()["published"] == published
	}, "actual owner outbox publication")
}
func (h t18ActualHTTP) complete(plan domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult {
	for _, item := range plan.Assessments {
		// Correctness stays inside this trusted test client. No answers/keys are
		// returned as metadata, logged, copied to Planner, or put into events.
		var task struct {
			ID    string `json:"id"`
			Tests []struct {
				ID       string `json:"id"`
				Kind     string `json:"kind"`
				Variants []struct {
					ID        string `json:"id"`
					IsCorrect bool   `json:"is_correct"`
				} `json:"variants"`
			} `json:"tests"`
		}
		h.request(http.MethodGet, h.courseURL+"/internal/task/get-internal-task/"+item.TaskID, os.Getenv("T18_COURSE_TOKEN"), "", nil, http.StatusOK, &task)
		if task.ID != item.TaskID || len(task.Tests) == 0 {
			h.t.Fatal("actual trusted Course quiz missing")
		}
		answers := []map[string]string{}
		for _, question := range task.Tests {
			variantID := ""
			for _, variant := range question.Variants {
				if variant.IsCorrect {
					if variantID != "" {
						h.t.Fatal("curated single-choice fixture has ambiguous key")
					}
					variantID = variant.ID
				}
			}
			if question.Kind != "single_choice" || variantID == "" {
				h.t.Fatal("curated supported single-choice fixture required")
			}
			answers = append(answers, map[string]string{"test_id": question.ID, "variant_id": variantID})
		}
		h.request(http.MethodPost, h.studentURL+"/api/v1/student/diagnostic-assessments/"+plan.ID+"/tasks/"+item.TaskID+"/submit", "", uuid.NewString(), map[string]any{"answers": answers}, http.StatusOK, nil)
	}
	key := uuid.NewString()
	var result, replay domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult
	address := h.studentURL + "/api/v1/student/diagnostic-assessments/" + plan.ID + "/complete"
	h.request(http.MethodPost, address, "", key, map[string]any{}, http.StatusOK, &result)
	h.request(http.MethodPost, address, "", key, map[string]any{}, http.StatusOK, &replay)
	if replay != result || domain.ValidateDiagnosticResult(result, plan) != nil || result.Correct != len(plan.Assessments) {
		h.t.Fatal("actual registered completion/scorer/replay failed")
	}
	return result
}
func t18ActualFetchOwn(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, sub *natsgo.Subscription, planID string, processor diagnosticplan.PlacementConsumer) *natsgo.Msg {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(20 * time.Second)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		messages, err := sub.Fetch(1, natsgo.MaxWait(time.Second))
		if errors.Is(err, natsgo.ErrTimeout) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil || len(messages) != 1 {
			t.Fatal("actual durable fetch failed")
		}
		message := messages[0]
		if message.Header.Get("X-Correlation-ID") == planID {
			return message
		}
		_ = diagnosticnats.HandleDiagnosticResultMessage(ctx, message, processor)
	}
	t.Fatal("actual own result delivery unavailable")
	return nil
}
func t18ActualEventMessage(t *testing.T, event domain.DiagnosticResultCommittedEvent) *natsgo.Msg {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := json.Marshal(event)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("safe event encoding failed")
	}
	message := natsgo.NewMsg(domain.SubjectDiagnosticResultCommitted)
	message.Data = raw
	message.Header.Set("X-Event-ID", event.EventID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Correlation-ID", event.CorrelationID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Causation-ID", event.CausationID)
	message.Header.Set("X-Schema-Version", "1")
	return message
}
func t18ActualCount(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool, query, studentID string) int64 {
	t.Helper()
	var count int64
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, query, studentID).Scan(&count) != nil {
		t.Fatal("actual Planner fact read failed")
	}
	return count
}
func t18ActualEventually(t *testing.T, limit time.Duration, check func() bool, label string) {
	t.Helper()
	deadline := time.Now().Add(limit)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		if check() {
			return
		}
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	t.Fatalf("timed out waiting for %s", label)
}
func t18ActualReadMetadata(t *testing.T, env string, output any) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Getenv(env))
	if err != nil || json.Unmarshal(raw, output) != nil {
		t.Fatal("SETUP: safe owned provider metadata unavailable")
	}
}
func t18ActualWriteExclusive(t *testing.T, path string, value any) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("safe evidence encoding failed")
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path+".tmp", os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("exclusive safe evidence creation failed")
	}
	_, writeErr := file.Write(append(raw, '\n'))
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if writeErr != nil || closeErr != nil {
		t.Fatal("safe evidence write failed")
	}
	if os.Link(path+".tmp", path) != nil || os.Remove(path+".tmp") != nil {
		t.Fatal("exclusive atomic evidence publication failed")
	}
}

// Observe broker settlement independently of the processing callback: success
// in PostgreSQL must be followed by the actual durable ACK before shutdown.
func t18ActualAwaitACK(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, brokerURL string) {
	t.Helper()
	connection, err := natsgo.Connect(brokerURL, natsgo.Timeout(5*time.Second))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("ACK observer connection unavailable")
	}
	defer connection.Close()
	js, err := connection.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("ACK observer JetStream unavailable")
	}
	t18ActualEventually(t, 5*time.Second, func() bool {
		info, err := js.ConsumerInfo(diagnosticnats.DiagnosticResultStream, diagnosticnats.DiagnosticPlacementDurable, natsgo.Context(ctx))
		return err == nil && info.NumAckPending == 0
	}, "actual durable ACK after committed placement")
}
